text: Testing plays an important role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of the code, such as individual functions, to make sure they work correctly. Integration tests go further and check how different parts of the system work together. Many developers use test-driven development, which means they write tests before writing the actual code. This approach helps them think carefully about what the code should do. Tests also give developers confidence. When all tests pass, the team knows that changes have not broken existing features. As a result, they can improve the software more quickly and safely.
